notes.title: Józek's Car
notes.notes:
[p]What car did the best driver behind the iron curtain drive? [/p][p]Józek Środa, yes the one who's knee injury ended his career, drove a car that he stole part by part from the factory that he worked at and then slowly assembled in a back alley. The one and only “[b]Biat 126b[/b]”!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45581631/aaeb7822c72ad5c0c81081e5381fba472bc77866.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Turbo Liar: Rust & Fast[/b] the story telling racing game that makes you at first question Józeks sanity and then your own. Discover the psyche of an eastern european boomer who had a little too much to drink![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45581631/426a826a752bbeb9d33a43e0d727a7222fad6042.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Feel the thrill of driving 200 km/h in a car that probably shouldn’t do 80! Or Get comfortable, light a cigarette and explore the unforgettable city of [b]Bielsko-Biała[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Bielsania chronicle[/i][/b][/h3][p][b][i]Hello dear reader,[/i][/b][/p][p][i]Today's foggy day was taken by storm when a cunning but reckless worker at FSM tried to steal  an entire engine block by throwing it over the fence. His mischievous plan was shattered when a group of local kids took the engine for themselves after they helped the man with it. The factory realised what happened when the worker himself reported the stolen engine.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist! And don’t miss Józek’s incredible stories.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45581631/73a66a6f5cc5e9a149b3081e7d03467cb5595a29.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Turbo Liar: Rust & Fast Now on Steam!
notes.notes: [p]Do you remember the times when the cars were livelier, roads smoother, and petrol prices didn’t make you question your life choices? [/p][p]Well Józek does! And he will for sure remind you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Turbo Liar: Rust & Fast[/b] is a storytelling racing game! Told by an unreliable narrator and protagonist  - Józek Środa. You can play out the stories of his yesteryears of [b]racing!, chasing!, being chased![/b] and dismantling the mafia while doing back flips![/p][previewyoutube="tISWrSYsZzg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Explore and break the protagonist's psyche, discover repressed memories and choose your own adventure with real time driving decisions. [/p][p]You will find yourself in cars with real unforgiving character inspired by the classics like: [b]Fiat 126p[/b], [b]Polonez mr78[/b], [b]syrena 105[/b] and many more. Driving through the historical and industrial city of [b]Bielsko-Biała[/b] throughout time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45581631/2e0a58984c33e2d65abe38c583cbc9eb91f9c95d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Bielsania chronicle[/i][/b][/h3][p][b][i]Hello dear reader,[/i][/b][/p][p][i]Today's peaceful day at the main Bielsko-Biała train station was interrupted as a 13 year old drove a car stolen from his father on the train tracks. The child lodged the car between the tracks which was hit by an incoming train as the young driver looked from the side in terror. Fortunately no one was hurt except the fathers wallet.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist! And stay tuned for more news about the game and Józeks incredible stories![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45581631/73a66a6f5cc5e9a149b3081e7d03467cb5595a29.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
